notes:
### Added
- Edit saved models: right-click a card (or its "⋯" button) → Edit details
  to change name, category, tags and notes. When name or category changes,
  the item folder is moved to match (empty folders are cleaned up).
- Remove models: right-click → Remove from library…, after a confirmation
  the item folder is moved to `<library>/_trash` (recoverable, nothing is
  deleted). `_trash` and `_updates` are ignored when scanning.

### Fixed
- Library window reopened after being closed stayed on "connecting" and
  Save did nothing: a closed HtmlDialog no longer delivers its callbacks, so
  every opening now creates a fresh window.
